bind_dregg_channel.description: Bind IBC channel/port after handshake (also used by migrate).

create_series_collection.description:
Create a collection under a rate-limited series (see SeriesConfig). The series must
exist; the cadence is enforced here for every sender, including the owner.

create_svg_collection.description:
Create a new cw721-svg collection.
Uses instantiate2 for deterministic, anti-collision address prediction.

recv_dregg_packet.description: DREGG runtime submits a commitment packet (same bytes as IBC recv).

set_series.description: Owner-only: set (Some) or remove (None) a series config.

update_code_id.description: Owner-only: update the cw721-svg code ID used for new collections.

update_oracle_pricing.description:
Owner-only: set (Some) or clear (None) the default oracle pricing for new
collections. Existing collections are unchanged.

update_ownership.description:
Update the contract's ownership. The `action` to be provided
can be either to propose transferring ownership to an account,
accept a pending ownership transfer, or renounce the ownership
permanently.

collection_info_extension.description: Optional extension of the collection metadata

creator.description: Sets the creator of collection. The creator is the only one eligible to update `CollectionInfo`.

minter.description:
The minter is the only one who can create new NFTs.
This is designed for a base NFT that is controlled by an external program
or contract. You will likely replace this with custom logic in custom NFTs

mint_start_time.description: Timestamp of mint start. If less than current block, mints available

packed.description:
SVP1-packed template + variables (`cw-svg-pack`). Required on create.
Stored once under its own key; empty in stored config / collection info.

price_tiers.description: Price tiers for minting. Empty or None = free mint.

require_auth.description:
When true, every mint must include valid ADR-36 `ext` auth
(`CosmosArbitrary` over DST+nonce[|digest]). Required for trustless
pledge collections; default false preserves open-mint SVG drops.

whitelist.description: Optional merkle whitelist contract address. Whitelisted minters bypass fees.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: cw721_svg_contract_PriceTier
definitions.description:
A price tier that applies until the mint count reaches `until_count`.
Tiers must be sorted ascending by `until_count`.
Example: [{ until_count: 100, price: 1_000_000utoken }, { until_count: 500, price: 5_000_000utoken }]
means: first 100 mints cost 1 token, mints 101-500 cost 5 tokens.

price.description: Price per token in this tier

until_count.description: This tier applies while mint_count < until_count

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256
cosmwasm_std_timestamp_Timestamp
cw_svg_minter_state_SeriesConfig
definitions.description:
Contract-enforced creation cadence for a named series (e.g. "latent-benders", "marain-orbs").
Every field is optional; an unset field is not enforced.

max_mint_window_secs.description:
If set, each collection must set mint_end_time (seconds after creation) and it must be
at most this value.

max_per_window.description: At most this many collections per rolling `window_secs`.

min_interval_secs.description: Minimum seconds between two collections of this series.

operators.description: Who may create in this series besides the factory owner. Empty = anyone.

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_OraclePricing
definitions.description:
Optional oracle pricing for a minting contract.

Absent, or `enforce == false`: only the default asset is accepted and
payment behaves as before. The oracle queries still answer, so a frontend
can show prices before enforcement is switched on.

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_AltAsset
definitions.description: An alternate asset accepted in place of `base_denom`.

base_decimals.description: Decimals of the base denom (e.g. 6 for uterp).

base_denom.description: The default mint asset this alt is priced against.

combine.description: How feed values are combined. Default median.

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_PriceAsset
definitions.description: An asset priced by the oracle: a native/IBC/factory denom or a cw20 address.

oracle.description: Oracle contract address (registry, aggregator or probe, matching `kind`).

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_FeedKind
definitions.description: What to read from one oracle contract.

aggregator_median.description:
Aggregator `Median { market_id, window }`. The height comes from the
aggregator's registry `Latest`, so staleness checks still apply.

probe_twap.description: TWAP probe `ArithmeticTwap { pool_id }`. Carries no height.

twap.description: Registry `Twap` over the newest `window_blocks` heights ending at the latest observation.

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_AggregateMethod
definitions.description: How several values are combined into one.

mean.description:
Weighted by `Feed::weight` (default 1) when combining feeds, and by
nothing when combining a history window.

weighted.description:
Weighted by observation count (`PricePoint::observations`) when combining feeds,
and by block gap (piecewise constant, like the registry TWAP) on a history window.

alt_in_base.description:
Feed value = base units per 1 alt (in display units). E.g. feed
`ATOM/TERP = 12.5`, base TERP, alt ATOM: 1 ATOM costs 12.5 TERP.

base_in_alt.description: Feed value = alt units per 1 base (in display units).

definitions.name: terp_oracle_types_PricingPolicy
definitions.description: Guards applied to every price read.

max_deviation.description: Max relative spread between any feed and the combined price, e.g. 0.05.

max_staleness_blocks.description:
Max `env.block.height - observation.height`. Requires feeds that record
local (terp) heights. `None` disables the check.

min_observations.description: Min total observations behind the combined price. Default none.

min_sources.description: Min number of feeds that must answer. Default 1.

slippage.description:
Accepted underpayment against the quote, e.g. 0.01 = pay at least 99%.
Overpayment is refunded.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_decimal_Decimal
definitions.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 = (2^128 - 1) / 10^18

definitions.name: cw_ownable_Action
definitions.description: Actions that can be taken to alter the contract's ownership

accept_ownership.description:
Accept the pending ownership transfer.

Can only be called by the pending owner.

renounce_ownership.description:
Give up the contract's ownership and the possibility of appointing
a new owner.

Can only be invoked by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is canceled.

transfer_ownership.description:
Propose to transfer the contract's ownership to another account,
optionally with an expiry time.

Can only be called by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is overwritten.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Expiration
definitions.description:
Expiration represents a point in time when some event happens.
It can compare with a BlockInfo and will return is_expired() == true
once the condition is hit (and for every block in the future)

never.description: Never will never expire. Used to express the empty variant
